BEFORE YOU START

Clear answers.
A better brief.

How long does a pilot take?+

The schedule is agreed after reviewing the inputs and access requirements. The proposal sets milestones, review points, and dependencies so the delivery plan reflects the actual work.

What do you need from us?+

Start with a workflow description, a few non-sensitive examples, and what a useful result would look like. Access to private data is agreed separately before it is shared.

How will we judge the result?+

We agree representative test inputs and acceptance criteria before development. The review covers useful results, failure cases, and the limits of the implementation.

What do we receive at handover?+

The written scope defines the agreed code, setup instructions, evaluation notes, and walkthrough. Hosting accounts, third-party dependencies, ownership terms, and any support period are made explicit.
